newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq says Turkey, Israel, U.S. form alliance.
newsitem.headline: Iraq says Turkey, Israel, U.S. form alliance.

text.p: Iraq's ruling Baath party newspaper al-Thawra on Sunday accused Turkey, Israel and the United States of forming an anti-Arab military alliance and urged Arab rulers to unite and confront it.
"...The U.S. has worked to set up a military alliance between Turkey and the Zionist entity (Israel) and joined it as the third party," said al-Thawra in a front-page editorial.

"In February last year the two parties (Israel and Turkey) signed a military agreement allowing each other to use its air space in training and exchange of information...In December this year the two sides signed a military cooperation agreement for 1997," said the editorial.
The paper said in order to confront such "threats" Arab governments were "urged to leave apart differences, hatred, fragmentation and internal problems and work for a united Arab front".
